title: Akiyama Mizuki — Obsessed With Cuteness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I attended school, and today's classes were so boring.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should just go home... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
If I put this here...like this.
And then this part here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it's working well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All by yourself in a lonely place as usual, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh my. Is that you, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's me. What're you up to, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean this robot? As you can see, I'm outfitting it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, this stumpy little thing's a robot too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're using it for one of your shows?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I made it a long time ago, but with some modifications, it can be controlled remotely.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not very cute for something to be used in a show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was going to work on its appearance after I finished outfitting it. I haven't reached that part, yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see. Which means you haven't made any costumes for it either, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Costumes? Yes, I may need to give it something to wear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? If you don't mind, I can make something for it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'll make it super cute too♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Cute, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You haven't changed at all.
Still the same old Mizuki with a weakness for anything cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah, you finally turned around.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You haven't changed either, always so focused on your tinkering even when you're talking to someone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it's a habit already.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And as for the costume...
I'm going to give this robot to a friend of mine to use.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be making it look like that friend as well, so would you be able to make something to go along with that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can! It sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now how should I go about doing this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should just leave school and start making it now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, Mizuki, what inspired you to come to school today for a change, anyway? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, nothing? Everything's fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you say so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I did get to talk to the legendary school weirdo, so coming to school today on a whim was well worth it♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, that's a great honor indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Encountering a rarely seen student in the wild has put me in quite a good mood as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aha, so that makes two of us, eh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, once you're done fixing up the robot, let me know. I'll make it the cutest outfit anyone has ever seen!
